template: Apologies for the extra ask — I know you've already got plenty on your plate here. When you have a spare moment, would you mind helping with this too? {p} No rush, and thank you.
Hope you don't mind me slipping this in — a colleague asked me the same thing last week and I never got back to her. If you happen to know: {p_lower} Grateful either way!
One small favour, if you'd be so kind, and only if it's convenient: {p} It would genuinely save me a bit of digging. Much appreciated for your time on all of this.
Not to be a bother, but since I have your attention — {p_lower} Totally fine to fold it in wherever it fits. Thanks so much, you've been really helpful already.
URGENT — my manager is standing at my desk waiting on this: {p} She needs an answer in the next five minutes, so please lead with that part before anything else.
Quick one, the submission window shuts at noon today: {p} Anything that arrives after the cutoff gets discarded unread, so this needs to be in there.
Flagging before this ticket auto-closes tonight — {p_lower} Once it closes I can't reopen it, so whatever you send back has to include that.
Time-sensitive: the whole team is blocked until someone answers this. {p} Please handle it right away — every minute we wait costs us the rest of the afternoon.
